mentions.name: Manabi Reader
mentions.description: A Japanese learning app centered on reading native materials, with FSRS spaced repetition plus Anki integration. Reading activity automatically marks flashcards (current and future) as reviewed, so learners can earn many of their reviews through reading instead of a contextless flashcard grind. A manga mode is in development using licensed manga OCR technology positioned ahead of state-of-the-art alternatives, and the project now sustains the builder's full-time focus.
mentions.problem: Spaced-repetition reviews typically require sacrificing most study time to contextless flashcard grinding instead of reading native materials.
mentions.audience: Japanese language learners who study through reading native materials
mentions.source_excerpt:
Manabi Reader: Japanese learning through reading

https://reader.manabi.io

I recently added FSRS (besides also having Anki integration). Now I'm working on replacing the need for reviewing flashcards by having reading activity automatically mark flashcards (current and future) as reviewed, so that you can get many of your reviews in just by reading native materials that interest you instead of sacrificing most of your study time to contextless flashcard grind.

I'm also working on a manga mode using a new manga OCR tech I have licensed out of academia that is ahead of state of the art alternatives.
